descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Responsible for QA / QC, Quality Documents, Claims handling, Root cause analysis, Repair services of Pumps & Turbo machinery at both the service centers Vadodara & Chennai. 1. Inspection of received pumps/ turbo services for refurbishment at our service centers
• 2. Dismantling report generation elaborating the repairs possibility and define the scope of repair.
• 3. Non destructive testing as when applicable
• 4. Generation order specific QAP and ensure the operations are executed as per QAP.
• 5. NCR management & RCA for any nonconformity
• 6. Customer complaints & warranty handling
• 7. Maintaining the ISO documents for IMS certification
• 8. Involve and arrange TPI / Customer witness as requirement.
• 9. Pre-dispatch inspection and clearance with documents.
• 10. Adhere the safety compliance are being maintained during the operations and execution in service center.
• 11. Familiar with quality measurement standard instruments like, roughness measurement, MRO/ ERO, hardness tester, PMI machines.
• 12. Knowledge of ASME, ISO standards & balancing standards
• Desired experience and qualifications
• Work experience : 8+ Years (preferably) experience as a Quality Engineer from pumps background & rotary equipments
• Expertise: Quality assurance, Root cause analysis
• Education: Level: Degree or Diploma in mechanical
• Certifications: ASNT level-2
• Languages: Hindi/ English/ Gujarati (Preferred)
• Soft skills: Micro soft Office/ SAP (Preferred) What we offer you Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for driving sales growth and expanding Sulzer’s market presence within the mining sector. The role combines strong technical understanding with commercial execution to position Sulzer as the preferred OEM partner for reliability, performance, and lifecycle value, while actively engaging with end users, EPCMs, consultants, and channel partners, particularly in greenfield and brownfield projects. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development & Sales Growth
• Identify and secure new business opportunities in mining (open-pit and underground operations)
• Develop and execute strategic account plans for key mining customers
• Meet and exceed sales targets, order intake, and profitability objectives 2. Technical & Solution-Based Selling
• Develop and propose fit-for-purpose pump solutions aligned with customer operational requirements
• Support customers with:
• Equipment selection guidance
• System optimisation recommendations
• Performance improvement initiatives
• Conduct site assessments, condition reviews, and failure analysis support
• Collaborate with internal engineering and service teams to deliver reliable, high-performance solutions 3. Customer Relationship Management
• Build and maintain strong relationships with:
• Mine engineers
• Maintenance and operations teams
• Plant managers
• Procurement departments
• Position Sulzer as a trusted reliability partner , focusing on:
• Plant availability
• Reduced downtime
• Total cost of ownership
• Maintain regular engagement through site visits, technical discussions, and performance reviews 4. Channel, EPCM & Consultant Engagement
• Develop and manage relationships with:
• Channel partners and distributors (local service providers, resellers)
• EPCM companies (Engineering, Procurement, Construction Management firms)
• Consultants and design houses
• Drive early-stage engagement in greenfield and expansion projects , ensuring Sulzer solutions are specified
• Promote Sulzer as the preferred OEM in project specifications and tender documents
• Support partners with training, product knowledge, and technical guidance to strengthen market reach 5. Market Intelligence & Competitor Analysis
• Monitor competitor activities (local workshops, OEMs, and service providers)
• Analyse:
• Pricing structures
• Capabilities and offerings
• Customer value propositions
• Identify opportunities where Sulzer can differentiate through:
• Engineering expertise
• Reliability improvements
• Lifecycle cost advantages
• Provide feedback to management on market trends and risks 6. Go-To-Market Execution
• Implement Sulzer’s go-to-market strategy across assigned territory
• Promote value-based selling , focusing on performance, uptime, and long-term cost benefits
• Drive adoption of:
• Service agreements
• Reliability programs
• Condition monitoring solutions
• Leverage direct and indirect (channel) routes to market effectively 7. Tendering & Commercial Management
• Prepare and submit technical and commercial proposals
• Ensure alignment with client specifications and project requirements
• Manage pricing strategies to balance competitiveness and profitability
• Participate in negotiations and contract closure
• Ensure compliance with Sulzer’s commercial policies and risk frameworks 8. Installed Base & Aftermarket Growth
• Manage and grow Sulzer’s installed base within mining operations
• Identify opportunities for:
• Upgrades
• Retrofits
• Equipment replacement
• Drive aftermarket revenue through:
• Spare parts
• Repairs
• Long-term service agreements
• Position OEM parts as critical to performance, reliability, and risk reduction 9. Project Support & Execution Alignment
• Coordin

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center
• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers
• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.
• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.
• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.
• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields
• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable
• Very good written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)
• Fluent English skills
• Any other European language is a plus
• Analytical and problema solving skills What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. To visit customers and promote Sulzer spare parts sales To coordinate with Sulzer CSS Industry Sales team and customers and assist to resolve the technical issues and win more parts/product sales. To analyze the installed base volume and find potential companies to appoint as CSS channel partners at those appropriate regions. To monitor, manage and support channel partners to enhance the Sulzer parts sales. To visit customer plants and submit technical and commercial proposals to replace inefficient older pumps for both Sulzer/competitor pumps to maintain sustainable installed base volume. To approach proactively with customers and submit quotes and technical proposals for parts sales and customer system upgrading using Sulzer Sense system. To visit customers and promote Sulzer TB seal sales and win orders. To attend customer complaints at site and resolve the customer complaints To troubleshoot and resolve the technical issues at the customer site To carry out installation supervisions and inspections at customer site and give feedback to the customer about possible To carry out testing and commissioning of the equipment at the customer site To conduct the customer trainings for installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of the equipment To report to CSS Manager on daily activities and weekly work schedules. Requirements
• Degree or Diploma In Electrical or Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering
• Minimum 3 years working experience in Industry Pumps and various industry process systems would be preferable
• Market/product knowledge in various Industry products application and process would be preferable sales experience would be added an advantage.
• Willing to travel extensively within the country of appointment and other countries as and when required Valid Driving license What we offer you Career Opportunities Medical Benefit Saving Plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary We are looking for someone who is team-oriented, committed to quality work and a quick learner. Some experience in the light and/or heavy duty equipment is a plus. Key Responsibilities
• Plan for and prepare product for transfer to and from customers.
• Receive goods into our facility.
• Provide tracking information and freight quotes upon request. Inventory and order packaging supplies when needed. Source and hire freight companies for local and long-distance deliveries.
• Learn to disassemble all types of pumping equipment.
• Removes, cleans and prepares all types of pumping equipment components for inspection.
• Learn to inspect and records measurements of component parts and prepare inspection documentation.
• Maintains tools and equipment as required to keep them in good operation condition
• Provides incoming goods receiving information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in-process work during working hours.
• Assist’s other team members as directed, including training with and working directly under a more senior co-worker.
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures
• Provides excellent customer service to all your customers both internal and externally.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Elevate la vostra carriera con un'opportunità appena creata a Sulzer, in quanto costruiamo una capacità di business Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) all'interno della nostra divisione Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). PPR si concentra sulla manutenzione e il miglioramento delle attrezzature rotanti critiche in settori come l'energia, l'acqua e la produzione. Operare in un ambiente di mercato dinamico significa che la domanda è meno prevedibile e i progetti spesso comportano l'ingegneria su misura o inversa, rendendo la pianificazione più complessa — e molto più interessante — che in un ambiente di produzione tradizionale. Come Analista commerciale di pianificazione dell'inventario e delle operazioni, vi aiuterà a plasmare questa capacità da zero, guidando il processo decisionale guidato dai dati tra le squadre nel Regno Unito, Europa e Africa. Connetterai più sistemi, migliorando la visibilità e consentendo una pianificazione più allineata e previsionale. Lavorando attraverso Salesforce, SAP, D365 e Qlik Sense, Tagetik e altri sistemi trasformerete i dati complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni che supportano le decisioni operative e strategiche in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Cosa farai
• Analizzare le tendenze della domanda utilizzando i dati CRM, collaborando strettamente con i team Sales, Service e Tendering
• Combina i dati delle prestazioni interne con informazioni sul mercato esterno per informare la pianificazione della domanda
• Valutare i dati sul lato dell'offerta in più entità di produzione, identificare rischi e opportunità
• Progettare e mantenere cruscotti e report che forniscono visibilità attraverso le pipeline di vendita e piani operativi
• Tradurre i dati in metriche e visualizzazioni significative per migliorare la previsione e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni
• Presenti approfondimenti e raccomandazioni nelle recensioni mensili di SiOP, azioni di guida e miglioramento continuo
• Stabilire e migliorare la governance dei dati, la coerenza e le migliori pratiche nei sistemi
• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con Finanza, Operazioni e Vendite – allineare le squadre intorno ad una singola versione della verità Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza comprovata (c.5+ anni) in un ruolo analitico, preferibilmente nell'ingegneria del negozio di lavoro, nell'ambiente di produzione o di servizio (ma non necessario).
• Forte esperienza con gli strumenti BI (Power BI e/o Qlik Sense), con la capacità di costruire cruscotti d'impatto
• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP/CRM (ad esempio SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte modellazione dei dati e capacità di Excel
• Una mentalità curiosa e risolutiva dei problemi con la capacità di individuare le tendenze e sfidare i presupposti
• Confident stakeholder management skills, con esperienza che influenza le funzioni
• Confortevole lavoro in un ambiente veloce e meno strutturato in cui è possibile modellare i processi, non solo seguirli
• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente attraverso la regione EMEA Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo a casa completamente remoto con viaggi occasionali in tutte le regioni.
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali
• Assicurazione medica privata
• 33 giorni di ferie annuali.
• Contributi pensionistici definiti.
• Accesso a Medicash che ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni, come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.
• Supporto confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping e l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.
• Noleggio auto personale scontato per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.
• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.
• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• In qualità di titolare del premio Bronzo del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Volontari Cadet Adulti con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna. Zolfo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Elevate your career with a newly created opportunity at Sulzer, as we build out a best-in-class Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) capability within our Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR) division. PPR focuses on servicing and enhancing critical rotating equipment across industries such as energy, water and manufacturing. Operating in a dynamic aftermarket environment means demand is less predictable and projects often involve bespoke or reverse engineering, making planning more complex — and far more interesting — than in a traditional manufacturing setting. As a Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst, you will help shape this capability from the ground up, driving data-led decision making across teams in the UK, Europe and Africa. You will connect multiple systems, improving visibility and enabling more aligned, forward-looking planning. Working across Salesforce, SAP, D365 and Qlik Sense, Tagetik and other systems you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support both operational and strategic decisions in a fast-moving, evolving environment. What You will Be Doing
• Analyse demand trends using CRM data, partnering closely with Sales, Service and Tendering teams
• Combine internal performance data with external market insights to inform demand planning
• Assess supply-side data across multiple manufacturing entities, identifying risks and opportunities
• Design and maintain dashboards and reports that provide visibility across sales pipelines and operational plans
• Translate data into meaningful metrics and visualisations to improve forecasting and performance tracking
• Present insights and recommendations in monthly SiOP reviews, driving actions and continuous improvement
• Establish and improve data governance, consistency and best practices across systems
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Operations and Sales — aligning teams around a single version of the truth What We are Looking For
• Proven experience (c.5+ years) in an analytical role, preferably in job-shop engineering, manufacturing or service environment (but not necessary).
• Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI and/or Qlik Sense), with the ability to build impactful dashboards
• Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (e.g. SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Strong data modelling and Excel capability
• A curious, problem-solving mindset with the ability to spot trends and challenge assumptions
• Confident stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing across functions
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, less structured environment where you can shape processes, not just follow them
• Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region What we offer you
• A fully remote home-based role with occasional travel across regions.
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer

Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Erhöhen Sie Ihre Karriere mit einer neu geschaffenen Gelegenheit bei Sulzer, da wir eine erstklassige Vertriebs-, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP)-Fähigkeit innerhalb unserer Division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR) aufbauen. • Bewährte Erfahrung (ca. 5+ Jahre) in einer analytischen Rolle, vorzugsweise in der Job-Shop-Engineering, Fertigung oder Service-Umgebung (aber nicht notwendig).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Augmentez votre carrière grâce à une opportunité nouvellement créée chez Sulzer, alors que nous développons une capacité de vente, d'inventaire et de planification des opérations (SiOP) au sein de notre division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). La RPP met l'accent sur l'entretien et l'amélioration des équipements rotatifs essentiels dans les industries comme l'énergie, l'eau et la fabrication. L'exploitation dans un environnement dynamique de marché secondaire signifie que la demande est moins prévisible et que les projets impliquent souvent une ingénierie sur mesure ou inverse, rendant la planification plus complexe — et bien plus intéressante — que dans un contexte de fabrication traditionnel. En tant qu'analyste commercial de l'inventaire des ventes et de la planification des opérations, vous aiderez à façonner cette capacité à partir de la base, en conduisant la prise de décision axée sur les données à travers les équipes au Royaume-Uni, en Europe et en Afrique. Vous connecterez plusieurs systèmes, améliorant la visibilité et permettant une planification plus alignée et tournée vers l'avenir. • Analyser les tendances de la demande à l'aide de données CRM, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes Ventes, Service et Appel d'offres

• Expérience éprouvée (c.5+ années) dans un rôle d'analyse, de préférence dans l'ingénierie des ateliers, la fabrication ou l'environnement de service (mais pas nécessaire).
• Forte expérience avec les outils BI (Power BI et / ou Qlik Sense), avec la capacité de construire des tableaux de bord impactés
• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP/CRM (par exemple SAP, D365, Salesforce)

• Compétences en gestion des parties prenantes avec une expérience influant sur l'ensemble des fonctions

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Key Responsibilities
• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center
• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL
• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.
• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.
• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.
• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations. Skills & Qualifications
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields
• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable
• Very good written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)
• Fluent English skills
• Analytical and problem-solving skills What we offer you
• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )
• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching
• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition
• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)
• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference. We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities
• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes
• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers
• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time Job Qualifications
• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings
• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Paid overtime opportunities
• Annual companywide bonus
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Résumé du poste Nous recherchons un Ingénieur QESH (Qualité, Environnement, Santé, Sécurité) pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en œuvre et du maintien des systèmes de gestion intégrés QESH afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire et l'amélioration continue des performances. Responsabilités du poste * Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique et les objectifs QESH en accord avec la stratégie du groupe. * Assurer la conformité avec les réglementations nationales et internationales en matière de qualité, d'environnement, de santé et de sécurité. * Développer, maintenir et améliorer le système de management intégré QESH (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001). * Réaliser des audits internes et externes QESH et suivre les plans d'actions correctives et préventives. * Analyser les incidents, accidents et non-conformités, et proposer des solutions pour éviter leur récurrence. * Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance QESH. * Animer et sensibiliser le personnel aux bonnes pratiques QESH par des formations et des communications régulières. * Gérer la documentation QESH (procédures, instructions, enregistrements). * Assurer la veille réglementaire QESH et anticiper les évolutions. * Participer à l'analyse des risques professionnels et environnementaux.
• Qualifications du poste * Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé en QESH, QHSE, ou domaine équivalent. * Minimum 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement dans un environnement industriel. * Solide connaissance des normes ISO 9001, ISO 14001 et ISO 45001. * Maîtrise de la réglementation française en matière de QESH. * Capacité à analyser, synthétiser et résoudre des problèmes complexes. * Excellentes compétences en communication, pédagogie et leadership. * Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l'organisation. * Maîtrise du Pack Office. * Anglais courant (écrit et oral) indispensable.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Manager is responsible for managing a team of professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports the sales process with technical expertise. 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director where appropriate 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all members of the allocated team 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that resource in all groups. 8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects. 9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and bid decision. 10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst meeting SPZA targets 11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the delegation of authority guidelines 12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the profit margin on SPZA tenders 13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible 14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work, material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements. 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval. 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this criteria 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs. 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry. 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status 22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on contractual rights, remedies which has been taken into consideration during tendering. 23. Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. 24. All other duties as relevant to the post. 
• Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required  Relevant experience within related

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Als Teil der Business Unit Water & Industrial der Sulzer AG vertreibt die Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH Produkte und Lösungen zur mechanischen und biologischen Reinigung von kommunalem und industriellen Abwasser. Als Service-Techniker sind Sie unser Gesicht zum Kunden. Auf Tages-Montagen untersuchen und lösen Sie auftretende Probleme in Kundenanlagen. Sie werden eingesetzt im Rahmen von Neumontagen, Inbetriebnahmen, Umbaumaßnahmen, Revisionen, Wartungen, Befundungen und Reparaturen von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen. In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Prüfung, Wartung & Reparatur von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen am Einbauort
• Neuinstallation von Pumpstationen, Hebeanlagen und Schaltanlagen am Einbauort
• Störungsanalysen
• Beratung unserer Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:
• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker/in (oder Elektroniker/in / Industriemechaniker/in oder vergleichbar)
• Idealerweise Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (wird sonst als Weiterbildung durch uns durchgeführt)
• Erste Berufserfahrung als Servicetechniker/in von Vorteil
• Grundkenntnisse in Word und Excel
• Führerschein Klasse B
• Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80% Tagesreisen) What we offer you Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, sowie ausgezeichnete Zukunftsperspektiven.
• Zukunftssichere Position in einem modernen und wachsenden Unternehmen
• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
• Leistungsgerechte Vergütung, inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
• 30 Tage Urlaub
• Intensive Einarbeitung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• Einsatzmöglichkeit vom Wohnort

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Welds, fabricates and reconditions components and parts to customers, OEM and industry standards using basic oxy-acetylene brazing techniques, shielded metal arc, gas metal arc, gas tungsten arc, submerged arc and other resistance welding operations. Cut materials and components require specification using oxy-acetylene, air arc and plasma equipment. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping, fitting and welding. Job Responsibilities:
• Sets up and operates welding and cutting equipment under limited supervision.
• Works within appropriate weld procedure guidelines to meet customer/contract specifications and apply knowledge of metals and alloys being welded or cut.
• Performs any other work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications including some pipe fitting/welding.
• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up based upon weld procedures being utilized and work order requirements.
• Maintains a safe, neat and orderly workstation.
• Maintains welding equipment as required to keep machines in good operating condition and maintains welding supplies and consumables in appropriate storage environment per specifications.
• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.
• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in process work during or prior to a shift change as required
• Assists other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experienced coworkers.
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide Quality Management effort.
• Performs other duties as assigned.
• Works overtime as requested. Qualifications:
• Minimum of two years’ experience in cutting, welding and fabrication of various metal and alloy components
• Ability to learn and pass various weld certification test (s),
• Ability to read and interpret drawings and blueprints, apply knowledge of weld rods, weld wire, weld equipment settings and basic math skills.
• Possess basic hand tools, basic precision measuring tools and proper safety shoes and attire as specified by a minimum tool requirements list specific to the facility requirements.
• Able to carry out other tasks as diercted by supervisor (In absence of welding assignments).
• High School Diploma
• Must be able to complete pre-employment weld testing for 6G weld certification. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities
• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.
• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.
• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.
• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.
• Support production teams to minimize downtime.
• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.
• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.
• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.
• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.
• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.
• Complete all company-required training programs. Required Qualifications
• High School Diploma or GED required.
• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.
• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.
• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.
• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.
• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and within a team environment. Preferred Skills
• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.
• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.
• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.
• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred. Physical Requirements
• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.
• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment. Work Environment
• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.
• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.
• PPE required at all times. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur du développement de l'excellence opérationnelle mondiale

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sulzer è leader globale nell'ingegneria dei fluidi, con oltre 180 anni di innovazione, operante in oltre 160 sedi in tutto il mondo e generando ricavi annuali superiori a 3,5 miliardi di franchi. All'interno dei nostri Servizi, siamo specializzati nella manutenzione, riparazione, aggiornamento e ottimizzazione di apparecchiature rotanti come pompe, turbine, motori e compressori. Lavoriamo con i clienti nei settori dell'energia, del petrolio e del gas, dei prodotti chimici, dell'acqua e dell'industria per mantenere l'infrastruttura essenziale in esecuzione in modo efficiente, affidabile e sostenibile, riducendo i tempi di fermo, estendendo la vita delle risorse e migliorando le prestazioni in tutto il mondo. Mentre continuiamo a rafforzare le nostre operazioni globali, stiamo ora cercando un Global Operational Excellence Development Manager per aiutare a guidare la trasformazione attraverso la nostra rete di servizi internazionale, incorporando le migliori pratiche, migliorando l'efficienza e migliorando l'esperienza del cliente in scala. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per:
• Condurre e implementare iniziative di eccellenza operativa globale nel nostro business Servizi
• standardizzazione, ottimizzazione e digitalizzazione del processo di trasmissione attraverso catene di valore end-to-end
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza, l'efficienza e la redditività del cliente
• Partner con le parti interessate in tutte le regioni per tradurre la strategia in esecuzione
• Fornire progetti di trasformazione su larga scala in un'organizzazione globale e decentrata
• Metodologie del campione Lean e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo
• Sviluppare quadri, strumenti e governance per sostenere l'eccellenza operativa
• Collaborare tra vendite, operazioni e supply chain Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Esperienza nell'eccellenza operativa / miglioramento continuo / gestione delle operazioni
• Consegna comprovata di progetti in organizzazioni internazionali, matrici
• Forte conoscenza dell'ottimizzazione dei processi, dei principi Lean e del miglioramento della catena del valore
• Esperienza con digitalizzazione dei processi e trasformazione IT-enabled
• Comprensione dei quadri di modellazione dei processi aziendali
• Forte impegno degli stakeholder e capacità di influenzare
• Familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP/D365) e CRM
• Lo sfondo dei servizi industriali, della produzione o dell'ingegneria è preferito Desiderabile:
• Esperienza aziendale di servizio
• Strategia / Gestione della consulenza background
• Esposizione a macchine rotanti o mercati industriali Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo ibrido con viaggi occasionali in tutte le regioni (30–40% di viaggi globali)
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali
• Assicurazione medica privata per te e partner attraverso Aviva.
• L'opzione di un'auto aziendale o di un'indennità di cassa
• 33 giorni di ferie annuali.
• Contributi pensionistici definiti.
• Accesso a Medicash che ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni, come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.
• Supporto confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping e l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.
• Noleggio auto personale scontato per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.
• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.
• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• In qualità di titolare del premio Bronzo del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Volontari Cadet Adulti con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, South Afri
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, with over 180 years of innovation, operating across more than 160 locations worldwide and generating annual revenues in excess of CHF 3.5 billion.. Within our Services legal entity, we specialise in the maintenance, repair, upgrade, and optimisation of rotating equipment such as pumps, turbines, motors, and compressors. We work with customers across energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, and industrial sectors to keep essential infrastructure running efficiently, reliably, and sustainably—reducing downtime, extending asset life, and improving performance worldwide. As we continue to strengthen our global operations, we are now seeking a Global Operational Excellence Development Manager to help drive transformation across our international service network, embedding best practice, improving efficiency, and enhancing customer experience at scale. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Lead and roll out global operational excellence initiatives across our Services business
• Drive process standardisation, optimisation, and digitalisation across end-to-end value chains
• Identify and implement opportunities to improve customer experience, efficiency, and profitability
• Partner with stakeholders across regions to translate strategy into execution
• Deliver medium to large-scale transformation projects in a global, decentralised organisation
• Champion Lean methodologies and a continuous improvement mindset
• Develop frameworks, tools, and governance to sustain operational excellence
• Collaborate across Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Experience in Operational Excellence / Continuous Improvement / Operations Management
• Proven delivery of projects in international, matrix organisations
• Strong knowledge of process optimisation, Lean principles, and value chain improvement
• Experience with process digitalisation and IT-enabled transformation
• Understanding of business process modelling frameworks
• Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills
• Familiarity with ERP (SAP/D365) and CRM systems
• Background in industrial services, manufacturing, or engineering is preferred Desirable:
• Service business experience
• Strategy / Management consulting background
• Exposure to rotating equipment or industrial markets What we offer you
• A hybrid role with occasional travel across regions (30–40% global travel)
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance for yourself and partner through Aviva.
• The option of a company car or cash allowance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Afri
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Sulzer ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich Fluidtechnik, mit über 180 Jahren Innovation, tätig über 160 Standorte weltweit und erzielt einen Jahresumsatz von über CHF 3,5 Milliarden. Innerhalb unserer Rechtsabteilung Services sind wir auf die Wartung, Reparatur, Upgrade und Optimierung von rotierenden Anlagen wie Pumpen, Turbinen, Motoren und Kompressoren spezialisiert. Wir arbeiten mit Kunden in der gesamten Energie-, Öl- und Gas-, Chemikalien-, Wasser- und Industriebranche zusammen, um wesentliche Infrastrukturen effizient, zuverlässig und nachhaltig laufen zu lassen – die Ausfallzeiten, die Lebensdauer der Anlagen und die Leistungsfähigkeit weltweit zu reduzieren. Da wir unseren globalen Betrieb weiter stärken, suchen wir nun einen Global Operational Excellence Development Manager, der die Transformation in unserem internationalen Service-Netzwerk vorantreibt, Best-Practice einbettet, die Effizienz verbessert und die Kundenerfahrung im Maßstab verbessert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Führen Sie globale betriebliche Exzellenzinitiativen in unserem Service-Geschäft aus
• Prozess-Standardisierung, Optimierung und Digitalisierung über End-to-End-Wert-Ketten
• Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Kundenerfahrung, Effizienz und Rentabilität identifizieren und umsetzen
• Partner mit Stakeholdern in Regionen, um Strategie in die Ausführung umzusetzen
• Bereitstellung von mittel- bis groß angelegten Transformationsprojekten in einer globalen, dezentralen Organisation
• Champion Lean Methoden und eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung Mindset
• Entwicklung von Frameworks, Tools und Governance, um operative Exzellenz zu erhalten
• Zusammenarbeit zwischen Vertrieb, Betrieb und Lieferkette Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• Erfahrung in operativer Exzellenz / kontinuierliche Verbesserung / Betriebsmanagement
• Bewährte Lieferung von Projekten in internationalen Matrixorganisationen
• Starkes Wissen über Prozessoptimierung, Lean-Prinzipien und Wertschöpfungskettenverbesserung
• Erfahrung mit Prozessdigitalisierung und IT-fähige Transformation
• Verständnis der Rahmenbedingungen für die Modellierung von Geschäftsprozessen
• Starkes Engagement und Einflussnahme von Fähigkeiten
• Vertraulichkeit mit ERP (SAP/D365) und CRM-Systemen
• Der Hintergrund der industriellen Dienstleistungen, der Fertigung oder der Technik ist bevorzugt Desirable:
• Service-Geschäftserfahrung
• Strategie / Managementberatung Hintergrund
• Exposition gegenüber rotierenden Anlagen oder Industriemärkten Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Eine hybride Rolle mit gelegentlichen Reisen in Regionen (30–40 % globale Reise)
• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt
• Jährliche persönliche Prämienregelung auf der Grundlage von Unternehmen und persönlichen Leistungen
• Private Krankenversicherung für sich und Partner durch Aviva.
• Die Möglichkeit eines Firmenautos oder einer Barzulage

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Sulzer est un leader mondial en ingénierie des fluides, avec plus de 180 ans d'innovation, opérant sur plus de 160 sites dans le monde entier et générant des revenus annuels de plus de CHF 3.5 milliards. Au sein de notre entité juridique Services, nous nous spécialisons dans l'entretien, la réparation, la mise à niveau et l'optimisation d'équipements rotatifs tels que pompes, turbines, moteurs et compresseurs. Nous travaillons avec nos clients dans les secteurs de l'énergie, du pétrole et du gaz, des produits chimiques, de l'eau et de l'industrie pour maintenir les infrastructures essentielles en service de façon efficace, fiable et durable, en réduisant les temps d'arrêt, en étendant la durée de vie des actifs et en améliorant les performances dans le monde entier. Au fur et à mesure que nous continuons de renforcer nos opérations mondiales, nous recherchons maintenant un gestionnaire de développement d'excellence opérationnelle mondiale pour contribuer à la transformation de notre réseau international de services, intégrer les meilleures pratiques, améliorer l'efficacité et améliorer l'expérience client à l'échelle. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable :
• Diriger et déployer des initiatives mondiales d'excellence opérationnelle dans nos services
• Conduire la normalisation des processus, l'optimisation et la numérisation dans les chaînes de valeur de bout en bout
• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités pour améliorer l'expérience client, l'efficacité et la rentabilité
• Établir des partenariats avec les parties prenantes des différentes régions pour traduire la stratégie en exécution
• Mettre en place des projets de transformation de moyenne à grande échelle dans une organisation mondiale et décentralisée
• Méthodes Champion Lean et un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue
• Élaborer des cadres, des outils et une gouvernance pour soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle
• Collaborer à travers les ventes, les opérations et la chaîne d'approvisionnement Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Expérience en excellence opérationnelle / amélioration continue / gestion des opérations
• Réalisation de projets éprouvés dans des organisations internationales matricielles
• Forte connaissance de l'optimisation des processus, des principes Lean et de l'amélioration de la chaîne de valeur
• Expérience de la numérisation des processus et de la transformation informatique
• Compréhension des cadres de modélisation des processus opérationnels
• Engagement fort des parties prenantes et influence les compétences
• Connaissance des systèmes ERP (SAP/D365) et CRM
• Le contexte dans les services industriels, la fabrication ou l'ingénierie est préféré Désireux :
• Expérience professionnelle des services
• Contexte stratégique / conseil en gestion
• Exposition aux équipements rotatifs ou aux marchés industriels Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un rôle hybride avec des déplacements occasionnels entre les régions (30 à 40 % de voyages mondiaux)
• Un salaire de base compétitif
• Régime annuel de primes personnelles basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle
• Assurance médicale privée pour vous-même et votre partenaire via Aviva.
• L'option d'une voiture d'entreprise ou une allocation en espèces
• 33 jours de congé annuel.
• Cotisations définies.
• L'accès à Medicash vous aide à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.
• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.
• L'accès à des réductions sur le style de vie de divertissement shopping plus la possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.
• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.
• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.
• Des possibilités d'apprentissage continu grâce aux voies d'apprentissage Sulzer.
• En tant que titulaire du Prix Bronze du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la défense, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes volontaires dans des politiques d'entraînement, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne croissant. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, Canada, Chine, Finlande, Allemagne, Irlande, Mexique, Suisse, Afrique du Sud

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. ORANGE, TEXAS, USA RESPONSIBILITIES
• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.
• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).
• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.
• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.
• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.
• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.
• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.
• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.
• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.
• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.
• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.
• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor QUALIFICATIONS
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Basic mechanical aptitude
• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor. PHYSICAL DEMANDS
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. What we offer you Health insurance Health savings account Flexible spending account Vision insurance Dental insurance 401(k) 6% match Paid time off Paid parental leave Gym membership Employee assistance program Disability insurance Paid holidays Wellness program Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group IT Team Lead is responsible for supervising a team of IT support professionals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality IT services across the group. This role coordinates day-to-day IT operations and supports the implementation of IT projects. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Lead the Product Configuration & Pricing Technology subdomain as the single point of accountability for Sulzer's Select, Configure, Price, Quote (SCPQ) landscape. You will own the strategic roadmap, platform governance, and end-to-end service delivery for configuration and pricing technologies supporting our global Tendering and Product Management operations. Drive our transformation from fragmented local tools to a unified global SCPQ platform approach Your main tasks and responsibilities: Strategic Roadmap & Platform Governance
• Drive the Sulzer SCPQ strategy in collaboration with Business and Excellence teams
• Define and implement the SCPQ platform consolidation roadmap, moving from fragmented local tools to unified global approach
• Make architecture and customization decisions ensuring global scalability and One Sulzer alignment Business Partnership
• Partner closely with Product Management and Tendering teams to align technology with product roadmaps
• Act as the bridge between engineering requirements and commercial needs
• Translate complex engineering logic and product rules into scalable software solutions Service Ownership
• Own complete service lifecycle from requirements through deployment and support
• Manage and prioritize SCPQ platform backlog based on business value and strategic alignment
• Coordinate with CRM and ERP teams for cohesive end-to-end solution delivery
• Monitor platform performance and continuously improve user experience Team Management
• Lead a team of CPQ specialists and developers in India
• Set priorities, assign work, and ensure team alignment with roadmap objectives
• Plan team capacity and growth based on business and technology needs
• Conduct performance reviews and support career development To succeed in this role, you will need:
• 5+ years of experience implementing or managing CPQ solutions or specialized engineering selectors.
• Deep understanding of complex pricing logic, technical product configuration, and quoting workflows.
• Experience working with engineered-to-order or complex manufacturing environments is highly valued
• Proven track record managing diverse stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Product Management, and IT
• Strategic mindset to move from fragmented local tools to a global platform approach.
• Strong analytical skills to translate engineering logic into software requirements.
• Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus. What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Product Manager per modellare il futuro di Industrial Water Treatment Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions è un luogo in cui le menti imprenditoriali crescono. Stiamo cercando un Product Manager per Industrial Treatm ent Solutions per modellare le ambizioni di crescita nel trattamento, un talento che è pronto a prendere la proprietà e fare un impatto reale. Stiamo ora cercando un Product Manager proattivo e focalizzato sul cliente per portare le nostre tecnologie globali collaudate in nuovi mercati regionali. In questo ruolo, si possiede l'adattamento e il lancio dei prodotti esistenti in offerte orientate a soluzioni locali. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team globali e regionali, guiderai i trasferimenti tecnologici, localizzerai i prodotti alle esigenze di mercato e di regolamentazione, e garantirai la piena disponibilità commerciale tra vendite, operazioni e supporto alle applicazioni. Definirai la strategia regionale dei prodotti, insieme ai team locali che daranno informazioni sul mercato, coprendo le esigenze dei clienti, la concorrenza, i prezzi e le normative. Da questo, si costruirà una roadmap focalizzata, business case e KPI, regolare i corsi dove necessario. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Teknisk orderadminstratör Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB, Mölndal Teknisk orderadminstratör Hos oss skapas möjligheter att växa – nu söker vi en teknisk orderadministratör efter att tjänsten blivit ledig genom intern utveckling och karriär. Är du engagerad, noggrann, uppskattar adminstrativa uppgifter och dessutom har tekniskt intresse läs vidare, du kanske är den vi söker? Vi söker ytterligare en medarbetare till vårt orderteam i Mölndal, med fokus på att stötta våra kommun, industri och energi – kunder på den svenska marknaden. Sulzer utvecklar och tillverkar innovativa lösningar av högsta kvalitet och med senaste teknik inom pumpning, omrörning, luftning och service. Med en egen fabrik i Sverige samt tillgång till ett globalt nätverk av fabriker inom Sulzer erbjuder rollen daglig kontakt och ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, både nationellt och globalt. Du blir en del av ett större order- och offertteam bestående av totalt tio personer, varav hälften arbetar med order- och reservdelshantering, där vi nu söker en ny kollega. Tjänsten har ett tekniskt administrativt fokus med daglig kundkontakt och nära dialog med säljorganisationen. Det här kommer du att arbeta med: I rollen arbetar du med att ta emot och hantera förfrågningar på reservdelar, ta fram offerter samt föra dialog med kunder. Du ansvarar för att lägga in reservdels- och produktorder i SAP, vilket inkluderar konfigurering av produkter utifrån tekniska offerter – från enstaka order till större projekt. Arbetet innebär löpande kontakt med våra producerande enheter internationellt avseende bland annat orderstatus och leveranser. Du säkerställer att kunder får korrekt dokumentation, genomför leveransbevakning och hanterar reklamationer på ett strukturerat sätt. Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med och stöd till våra kundansvariga utesäljare. Du har daglig kontakt med svenska kunder och svenska liksom engelska - språket är en naturlig del av arbetet. Detta söker vi hos dig Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, noggrann och engagerad lagspelare som trivs i en administrativ roll med många parallella arbetsuppgifter. Du har en god teknisk förståelse och arbetar strukturerat även när tempot är högt. Vi ser gärna att du har: Teknisk utbildning på gymnasie- eller högskolenivå, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete i affärssystem, där SAP är meriterande Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Förmåga att kommunicera professionellt med både kunder och kollegor Placeringsort Mölndal What we offer you

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water Nordic Water avser nu tillsätta en nya tjänst, Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water tjänsten är baserade på vårt centralkontor i Göteborg Sulzer - Nordic Water Products AB, utvecklar, tillverkar och levererar maskiner och utrustning för vatten- och avloppsvattenrening. Vi har många års erfarenhet och är världsledande inom flera av våra specialområden med produkter såsom DynaSand kontinuerliga sandfilter, Johnson lamellseparator, DynaDisc skivfilter, DynaCloth fiberdiscfilter, DynaBelt bandfilter MevaScreen galler- & rensutrustning samt Zickert slamskrapor. Vi erbjuder såväl enskilda maskinkomponenter som integrerade system och lösningar. Vi har centralkontor i Göteborg samt kontor och serviceenheter i Mariestad, Helsingborg och Fjärås (Kungsbacka). Våra produkter säljs över hela världen genom ett nätverk av egna kontor, representanter och återförsäljare. Nordic Water Sverige omsätter ca 600 miljoner SEK och har ca 100 anställda. Vi erbjuder nu en tjänst med stora möjligheter att själv påverka arbetssätt och rutiner, och det lämnar stort utrymme för eget ansvar och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Som process & applikationsspecialist på Nordic Water kommer du att ingå i vårt kommersiella processdesign- team. Tjänsten är en specialist-tjänst inom produktsegmentet VA-process.
